sn7.13:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā vātehi ābādhiko hoti ||
sn7.13:1.3: āyasmā ca Upavāno Bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti || || 3.
sn7.13:1.4: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Upavānam āmantesi || ||
sn7.13:1.5: Iṅgha me tvaṃ Upavāna uṇhodakaṃ jānāhīti || || 4.
sn7.13:1.6: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Upavāno Bhagavato paṭissutvā nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Devahitassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tuṇhībhūto ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 5.
sn7.13:1.7: Addasā kho Devahito brāhmaṇo āyasmantam Upavānam tuṇhībhutam ekam antam ṭhitaṃ ||
sn7.13:5.1: Atha kho Devahito brāhmaṇo uṇhodakassa kājam purisena gāhāpetvā phāṇitassa ca puṭam āyasmato Upavānassa pādāsi || || 8.
sn7.13:5.2: Atha kho āyasmā Upavāno yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam uṇhodakena nahāpetvā uṇhodakena phāṇitam āloḷetvā Bhagavato pādāsi || || 9.
sn7.13:5.3: Atha kho Bhagavato so ābādho paṭippassambhi || || 10.
sn7.13:6.1: Atha kho Devahito brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhim sammodi ||
sn7.13:6.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vitisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 11.
sn7.13:6.3: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Devahito brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.13:10.1: Evaṃ vutte Devahito brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.13:10.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || 2.
